ideas.title: The Rise of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the use of shell companies and the involvement of multiple business owners and individuals.
ideas.angle: The story would focus on the complexities of the schemes and the challenges faced by authorities in tracking and prosecuting those involved.
questions: What are the root causes of the surge in Medicaid fraud?
How are authorities working to combat the issue?
ideas.insight: The story would require a deep dive into the financial transactions and entities involved in the schemes, as well as interviews with authorities and experts.
